title: Slave Dynasty Rajia Sultan
definition: Razia Sultan (r. 1236–1240) was the first and only female Muslim ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, daughter of Iltutmish, who challenged the patriarchal norms of the Turkic nobility.
importanceInUpsc: Tests the candidate's understanding of gender dynamics in medieval politics, the power struggle between the Sultan and the 'Chahalgani' (Corps of Forty), and the administrative challenges of the early Delhi Sultanate.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Slave Dynasty Rajia Sultan.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
